post_text:
New York spends $26,571 per student.
Utah spends $8,154.
Utah has higher reading scores.

Explain that.

Ranked all 50 states by NAEP 4th-grade reading proficiency per $10,000 spent. The efficiency gap between #1 Utah (47.8 points per $10K) and #51 Washington D.C. (10.1 points) is 4.7x. Eight of the ten highest-spending states fall in the bottom half of the efficiency ranking. What separates the top ten? Structured literacy mandates, K-3 reading coaches, early intervention — none of which require record budgets to implement. Tennessee ranks 16th. $11,200 per pupil. Top third nationally.
